There is no hairline vertex group in the shipped anatomy (measured: all head joint groups are helper verts >= 13380, stripped; no MakeHuman hairline target; the forehead targets run to the crown). The materializer now derives the hairline per-body from the body's own surface: the forehead plane = median depth (y) of the head's midline surface within the fitted EYE MESH's own height band, and the hairline = the highest face-front vertex still at/ahead of that plane (aisha: 0.9715 H). Midline half-width = the eye mesh's own half-width. 60 scalp polys unpainted in the face front below the hairline.
